text: ya so dont get too deep into it just find the most sane solution to it and lets get the ball rolling
resolution: Made hmsc-int image-texture uploads portable across machines. Root cause: uploadFaceTexture stored the picked file's RAW absolute path on the decal node, so a rename broke it and a move to the MacBook double-broke it (the file isn't in the repo, and /home/siah doesn't exist on macOS; the data/ store that holds the decal is gitignored too). Fix: new ingestImage.ts copies the picked bytes into a content-addressed, repo-TRACKED folder (cart/hmsc-int/assets/tex/<hash>.<ext>) and returns a repo-relative ref; uploadFaceTexture now stores that ref instead of the path, so the texture travels with git push and survives a rename (keyed by content). Added migrateImagesIntoRepo.ts + a one-click 'make portable' button in FacePainter that rescues EXISTING path-based decals (run on the box where the sources still live; vanished sources are reported for re-upload). Pure rewrite walk unit-tested 4/4 green; FacePainter/uploadFaceTexture bundle clean under the real cart aliases. NOTE: still requires copying the gitignored data/ store to the Mac, and clicking 'make portable' + committing assets BEFORE pushing.
